data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2623 released $110.0m of prior year reserves in 2018. This was driven by increased reserve releases in the specialty lines division, particularly from the maturing post-recession portfolio (from 2012 onwards) and contributions from the cyber portfolio. These favourable developments were partially offset by lower releases in short-tail classes due to reduced margins and the impact of a series of natural disasters. The property division experienced a strengthening of $48.0m, primarily due to higher attritional claims and adverse development on 2017 catastrophe estimates.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year reserve release of $110.0m is stated in narrative text without explicit indication of whether it is gross or net of reinsurance. It is assumed to be net, as narrative often defaults to net figures. No gross prior year development figure was available from other sources (e.g., specific movement note or claims development triangle).
